correctness.rationale: The incomparable-class choices X=[w]_E,Y=[w]_F witness failure of conjunction closure. When all classes are comparable, their intersection is the smaller one, so S=K_(E intersection F) for every truth set, including nested formulas. A maximal class in each connected laminar block family covers its whole join-component, forcing either E or F to be indiscrete there. Counting connected labelled pairs gives 2 Bell(k)-1 and unlabelled oriented integer-partition types 2 p(k)-1; exponential and Euler-product formulas follow. Exact checker exhausts pairs through six worlds and valuation cases through four worlds. Computation corroborates but is not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Identifies the exact finite S5 boundary at which a well-studied non-normal epistemic operator is genuinely normal, then fully classifies the labelled and unlabelled frames of every size.
